criteria.title: 초기 finite state 구성
criteria.text:
primary curls 뒤temporal mean update와다섯moment correction을수행하여j=0 상태를만든다. 합격: Proposition9.5
의B0=0.7,C0*=1.2와(9.9),(9.10) 명세를충족한다. 명세의상수없이경험적power slope만으로인증하지않는다.
criteria.assessedBy: MathScope actual source and finite observation review
remaining: Assemble the required original bands and labels, then apply the actual temporal-mean and five-moment updates.
Recompute full pressure after both updates and establish the exact B0=0.7, C0*=1.2 and (9.9)-(9.10) class constants.
remainingObligations: Assemble the required original bands and labels, then apply the actual temporal-mean and five-moment updates.
Recompute full pressure after both updates and establish the exact B0=0.7, C0*=1.2 and (9.9)-(9.10) class constants.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The unchanged common6 source constructor has actually run. Its selected original band/member full curl, all six angular/Haar covariances, current P/J, and full auxiliary-torus pressure are reconstructed. Both original pulse systems have finite C4/C5 variations. This is still the pre-initialization state; Proposition9.5 j=0 has not been constructed.

criteria.title: 전체 residual 재계산
criteria.text:
R(u+δu,p+δp)=R(u,p)+Lu(δu,δp)+div(δu⊗δu)를사용하며매substep 후최신압력을복원한다. 합격: 독립직접PDE
평가와decomposed residual이오차예산내일치한다. 기존flat tail와새quadratic remainder를장부에서누락하지않
는다.
criteria.assessedBy: MathScope actual source and finite observation review
remaining: Construct full auxiliary pressure after the actual signed update and after every later correction substep.
Compare independent complete physical PDE evaluation with the full decomposed source residual, including the old flat tail, every quadratic product and explicit error budgets.
remainingObligations: Construct full auxiliary pressure after the actual signed update and after every later correction substep.
Compare independent complete physical PDE evaluation with the full decomposed source residual, including the old flat tail, every quadratic product and explicit error budgets.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The generic finite Fourier quadratic residual identity and omitted-square control remain passing evidence. The actual selected source now has complete initial auxiliary pressure with A0 retained; its signed wave update retains previous-curl, new-curl and square terms, recalculates all six mean covariances and reconstructs the updated mean pressure before Etheta/Ez. An independent complete physical PDE jet comparison after every source substep is not present.

criteria.title: 비영 angular harmonics 보정
criteria.text:
현재source의모든nonzero harmonics를(7.13) inverse로풀고source-supported potentials에cutoff 후curl한다.
합격: same-label 곱에서m+m′ 신규주파수가생성된다. 단계별최대harmonic을기록하고조용한truncation 대신
discarded-mode bound를제공한다.
criteria.assessedBy: MathScope actual source and finite observation review
remaining: Derive the complete same-label current harmonic coefficients from the updated source field.
Solve their actual projected transport equations and realize supported physical curls with commutators and justified mode tails.
remainingObligations: Derive the complete same-label current harmonic coefficients from the updated source field.
Solve their actual projected transport equations and realize supported physical curls with commutators and justified mode tails.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The finite harmonic ledger and independent projected ODE example remain separate from source reconstruction. Both authentic original pulse matrices now generate C4/C5 slow jets, their coefficient/time derivative FTC bodies, noncommuting 112-component variational systems and retained factorial ordered-integral tails. This closes the derivative-kernel dependency for the selected signed curl, not the actual complete current nonzero-harmonic correction.

criteria.title: Signed covariance increment
criteria.text:
고정positive a±에대해δa=(Hcov^−1(Σ/ε))/(2a)를사용한다. 새Σ는signed일수있다. 합격: B(W0,LΣ)=Σ와(7.41)의
세remainder를모두검사한다. 앞단계a±를새residual에맞춰몰래재선택하지않는다.
criteria.assessedBy: MathScope actual source and finite observation review
remaining: Assemble the complete source partition and verify the global averaged B(W0,L Sigma)=Sigma identity.
Apply this update to the initialized current stage with full pressure after the substep, and prove its original support/edge and all-order derivative-class bounds.
remainingObligations: Assemble the complete source partition and verify the global averaged B(W0,L Sigma)=Sigma identity.
Apply this update to the initialized current stage with full pressure after the substep, and prove its original support/edge and all-order derivative-class bounds.
criteria.acceptanceScope: A target is now derived from the actual current Etheta/Ez and P/J using retained Corollary8.5 radial inverses. The original H and positive a remain fixed. Both source-signed potential curls and their shared derivative bodies are constructed, all three (7.41) remainder families and new squares are retained, and updated full mean covariances/P/J are formed. The selected member has the correct eta_beta^2*Sigma principal identity; the global Sigma identity is not claimed for one member.

criteria.title: Zero auxiliary mean Fourier inverse
criteria.text:
(8.19)의1/(2πi vt·k) multiplier로(8.20)을풀고axial increment는(8.14)의potential로실현한다. 합격: zero mode가
0이고Nφ=F가맞는다. |vt·k|^−1≤C(1+|k|) 및4개추가도함수를포함한Fourier tail를기록한다.
criteria.assessedBy: MathScope actual source and finite observation review
remaining: Compute the actual zero-mean source coefficients and the original divisor/extra-four-derivative bounds for each required order.
Realize the axial potential and divergence-compatible radial update with A1 and all cutoff remainders retained in the next actual pressure/residual.
remainingObligations: Compute the actual zero-mean source coefficients and the original divisor/extra-four-derivative bounds for each required order.
Realize the axial potential and divergence-compatible radial update with A1 and all cutoff remainders retained in the next actual pressure/residual.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The exact algebraic divisor for vt=(sqrt(2)-1,1) and a declared finite Fourier inverse remain implemented. The actual full-torus initial pressure and residual expressions are now available as source inputs, and C5 pulse slow derivatives are retained. Neither those slow jets nor a finite Fourier fixture supply the required complete auxiliary Fourier coefficients and C^(m+4) tail constants.

criteria.title: 다섯 radial equations와 압력
criteria.text:
(8.25)로두보존모멘트와P,Jθ,Jz를보정하고(8.12)로pressure를다시계산한다. 합격: 두보존적분은0으로유지되고새
결함은(8.26),(8.27)의nonlinear remainder와일치한다. λ의작은값에따른condition number를통제한다.
criteria.assessedBy: MathScope actual source and finite observation review
remaining: Apply the authentic fixed mean map to these current defects after the temporal update.
Recompute the complete updated pressure and both conservation integrals, then verify (8.26)-(8.27) with all nonlinear current means and the original lambda-conditioned derivative bounds.
remainingObligations: Apply the authentic fixed mean map to these current defects after the temporal update.
Recompute the complete updated pressure and both conservation integrals, then verify (8.26)-(8.27) with all nonlinear current means and the original lambda-conditioned derivative bounds.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The original positive-lambda five-moment inverse was already connected to unchanged M2 helpers. Current P,Jtheta,Jz are now reconstructed from the selected complete primary curl, and recalculated after the actual signed update; full initial pressure and updated mean pressure are present. The five-moment inverse has not yet been applied to these current defects, so the two conservation equations and nonlinear (8.26)-(8.27) result are not asserted for a corrected stage.

criteria.title: 고정 도메인과 차수 향상
criteria.text:
σj=1/5+j/10, gj=hj/10 및(9.17),(9.18)의Km,ℓm,log powers를추적한다. 합격: 모든finite stage가같은q<qbig 도메
인을사용한다. 단한번의step에서샘플잔차가늘면정밀도/범위/상수부터조사하고차수theorem과혼동하지않는다.
criteria.assessedBy: MathScope actual source and finite observation review
remaining: Establish one common original qbig and all required constants for the complete initialized correction stages.
Carry every physical derivative loss and differentiated tail on that fixed domain; do not infer the order theorem from sample residual changes.
remainingObligations: Establish one common original qbig and all required constants for the complete initialized correction stages.
Carry every physical derivative loss and differentiated tail on that fixed domain; do not infer the order theorem from sample residual changes.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The rational exponent ledger remains exact. The actual source execution retains the original positive lambda/h, original first admissible band/member, fixed radial integration envelope, coefficient FTC norms and explicit Volterra tails. These are finite selected-chart constructions; no common all-stage qbig or all-order Km,ell_m and logarithmic constants have been proved.

criteria.title: 최종 local 합성
criteria.text:
(9.21)에서Aj,Bj,pj에shrinking cutoff를적용하고curl하여local field를만든다. finite residual의flat terms를무조건합
산하지않는다. 합격: Lemma5.4의tail 비교로(9.20)을연결한다. 평가구간의active indices와생략tail의bound를저장
하고없으면finite-stage approximation으로제한한다.
criteria.assessedBy: MathScope actual source and finite observation review
remaining: Construct the complete finite correction sequence from the actual j=0 state.
Choose and differentiate the shrinking cutoffs, prove their summable tails and perform the fixed-stage Lemma5.4 comparison.
Store the actual active indices and rigorously omitted tail for every evaluation domain.
remainingObligations: Construct the complete finite correction sequence from the actual j=0 state.
Choose and differentiate the shrinking cutoffs, prove their summable tails and perform the fixed-stage Lemma5.4 comparison.
Store the actual active indices and rigorously omitted tail for every evaluation domain.
